meta.purpose: Golden eval set — the single correctness backbone for the experiment (Decision D4).
used_by: S3 retrieval: every store must return expected_value for each item (correctness parity gate before timing)
S3 retrieval: the same items are the timed workload
S4 text-to-SQL: each model's drafted SQL is executed on DuckDB and checked vs expected_value
meta.expected_value: null until resolved — pipeline.resolve_eval runs canonical_sql on the DuckDB store (S2) and fills it. A few items carry a hand-checked 'known' anchor from public sources.
meta.tolerance_policy: TWO-TIER (Decision D6). Correctness GATE: numeric items must match the store/canonical expected_value within `tolerance` (1e-07 = float rounding only; PPG/RPG/ratios are EXACT rationals = sum/count, so anything looser would hide real bugs), counts and strings are exact. SEPARATE soft check: the optional `known` public anchors are rounded to 1 decimal, so they are compared within `known_tolerance` and are INFORMATIONAL sanity checks, never a pass/fail gate.

tables.game_logs: player_id, season(end-year int), game_date, opponent_abbr, is_playoff(0/1), min, pts, reb, ast, plus_minus  [LeagueGameLog, 5 recent seasons]
tables.players: player_id, full_name, team_abbr  [dim from latest season aggregates]
tables.player_season: player_id, player_name, team_abbr, season, season_type, gp, min, pts, reb, ast, ... , off_rating, def_rating, net_rating, usg_pct, ts_pct, efg_pct, pie, poss  [LeagueDashPlayerStats PerGame Base+Advanced, 30 seasons]
tables.bbref_advanced: bbref_slug, full_name, season, per, bpm, vorp, ws, ...  [Basketball-Reference, 2024-25]

items.question: What did LeBron James average in points per game in the 2024-25 regular season?
items.canonical_sql: SELECT AVG(pts) AS answer FROM game_logs WHERE player_id = 2544 AND season = 2025 AND is_playoff = 0
items.notes: row-wise game_logs aggregate (point lookup + filter). PPG is an exact rational.

items.question: How many rebounds per game did Stephen Curry average in the 2023-24 regular season?
items.canonical_sql: SELECT AVG(reb) AS answer FROM game_logs WHERE player_id = 201939 AND season = 2024 AND is_playoff = 0
items.notes: row-wise game_logs aggregate on a different metric.

items.question: How many regular-season games did Nikola Jokic play in 2024-25 (within our game-log window)?
items.canonical_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS answer FROM game_logs WHERE player_id = 203999 AND season = 2025 AND is_playoff = 0

items.question: What did Giannis Antetokounmpo average in points against Boston in the 2024-25 regular season?
items.canonical_sql: SELECT AVG(pts) AS answer FROM game_logs WHERE player_id = 203507 AND opponent_abbr = 'BOS' AND season = 2025 AND is_playoff = 0
items.notes: row-wise with opponent filter (small sample); resolver fills actual.

items.question: What did LeBron James average in points per game in the 2024-25 playoffs?
items.canonical_sql: SELECT AVG(pts) AS answer FROM game_logs WHERE player_id = 2544 AND season = 2025 AND is_playoff = 1

items.question: In the 2024-25 regular season, how many more points per game did LeBron average than Stephen Curry?
items.canonical_sql: SELECT (SELECT AVG(pts) FROM game_logs WHERE player_id = 2544 AND season = 2025 AND is_playoff = 0) - (SELECT AVG(pts) FROM game_logs WHERE player_id = 201939 AND season = 2025 AND is_playoff = 0) AS answer
items.notes: head-to-head row-wise comparison across two players.

items.question: Who led the NBA in points per game in the 2024-25 regular season (minimum 58 games)?
items.canonical_sql: SELECT player_name AS answer FROM player_season WHERE season = 2025 AND season_type = 'Regular Season' AND gp >= 58 ORDER BY pts DESC LIMIT 1
items.notes: leaderboard WITH min-games qualifier — the correctness rule. Hand-check anchor: SGA won the 2024-25 scoring title (~32.7).

items.question: Who had the highest points-per-game in 2024-25 with NO games qualifier (the trap)?
items.canonical_sql: SELECT player_name AS answer FROM player_season WHERE season = 2025 AND season_type = 'Regular Season' ORDER BY pts DESC LIMIT 1
items.notes: TRAP: without gp >= 58 a tiny-sample player can 'lead'. Demonstrates why the qualifier matters; expected likely differs from the qualified leader.

items.question: Who led the NBA in assists per game in the 2023-24 regular season (minimum 58 games)?
items.canonical_sql: SELECT player_name AS answer FROM player_season WHERE season = 2024 AND season_type = 'Regular Season' AND gp >= 58 ORDER BY ast DESC LIMIT 1

items.question: Across qualified players (>=58 games), what was the average points-per-game in 2024-25?
items.canonical_sql: SELECT AVG(pts) AS answer FROM player_season WHERE season = 2025 AND season_type = 'Regular Season' AND gp >= 58

items.question: Across qualified players (>=58 games), what was the average points-per-game in 1996-97?
items.canonical_sql: SELECT AVG(pts) AS answer FROM player_season WHERE season = 1997 AND season_type = 'Regular Season' AND gp >= 58
items.notes: concatenate-across-time: same query, earliest modern season.

items.question: Which qualified player had the best net rating in 2024-25 (minimum 58 games)?
items.canonical_sql: SELECT player_name AS answer FROM player_season WHERE season = 2025 AND season_type = 'Regular Season' AND gp >= 58 ORDER BY net_rating DESC LIMIT 1
items.notes: native advanced metric (net_rating) from nba_api Advanced.

items.question: Which qualified player had the highest usage rate in 2024-25 (minimum 58 games)?
items.canonical_sql: SELECT player_name AS answer FROM player_season WHERE season = 2025 AND season_type = 'Regular Season' AND gp >= 58 ORDER BY usg_pct DESC LIMIT 1

items.question: What was Nikola Jokic's VORP in 2024-25 (Basketball-Reference)?
items.canonical_sql: SELECT b.vorp AS answer FROM bbref_advanced b JOIN player_crosswalk x ON b.bbref_slug = x.bbref_slug WHERE x.nba_player_id = 203999 AND b.season = 2025
items.notes: CROSS-SOURCE JOIN on canonical crosswalk (nba_id -> bbref_slug). Hand-check anchor: repo EDA found Jokic led VORP at 9.8.

items.question: Who led the NBA in VORP in 2024-25 (Basketball-Reference)?
items.canonical_sql: SELECT full_name AS answer FROM bbref_advanced WHERE season = 2025 ORDER BY vorp DESC LIMIT 1
items.notes: derived metric only BBRef provides; tests the second source end-to-end.

items.question: What did Kevin Durant average in points per game in the 2023-24 regular season?
items.canonical_sql: SELECT AVG(pts) AS answer FROM game_logs WHERE player_id = 201142 AND season = 2024 AND is_playoff = 0
items.notes: second row-wise anchor for cross-store parity.
